outline:
This course enables the students know the fundamental concepts in materials science, modern theory of solids, and semiconductor physics/Devices. The introduction of electronic devices and semiconductor processing used in the current semiconductor industry are also included.
(Course taught in English)
schedule:
1. Introduction
2. Elementary Materials Science Concepts
3. Electrical  Conduction in Solids
4. Elementary Quantum Physics
5. Fundamentals of Semiconductor
6. Semiconductor Devices (LED and Solar Cell)
7. Materials processing and fabrication

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content: During Weeks 17–18, a total of 6 hours will be allocated for flexible learning. The course will be conducted through asynchronous distance learning. Students will engage in independent learning by watching digital video materials or reading the assigned materials.第17至18週共安排6小時彈性學習，採非同步遠距教學方式進行。學生透過觀看數位影音教材或閱讀指定教材，進行自主學習。
flexible_learning.outcome: Students will demonstrate their understanding of the course materials by completing and submitting the assigned assignments.學生繳交指定作業，展現對課程教材內容的理解與學習成果。
